15:27 Local Time, 13:27 GMT, 18:57 IST: Fantastic knock from Gerhard Erasmus has given Namibia a fighting score. They were three-down for not many when he joined Volschenk. The duo rebuilt the innings and then Erasmus took over. He targetted the deep backward square-leg region in particular as Zimbabwe kept the fielder in. He repeatedly shovelled Zimbabwe's plan to bowl well outside off by putting away those deliveries to the leg-side fence. Zimbabwe were very sloppy in the field with dropped catches, misfields and wayward throws. Not to mention the extras conceded in terms of wides. Still they should back themselves to chase this down. A pressure game and they have work to do. Back for their reply shortly...
